brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: A portable electronics organizer: a base
requirements.evidence: Hex base cells (0,0) full, (0,1) full, (1,0) half-w, (1,-1) full, (2,-1) full, joined with lockJoints; check_build ok, meshClash clear.
Bin hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) in cell (0,0) and hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) in cell (0,1). They drop in and hang on their rims, open from the top.
Slide drawer (addDrawer key e, style slide) on the east cut face of half-base cell (1,0).
Handle at (1,-1) top, on the triangle of covers at (1,0), (1,-1), (2,-1) with trinity inserts. Configurator accepted it.

Compact three-cell-footprint build with a carry grip, but the configurator does not judge weight or portability. Print estimate is about 2429 g and 3476 min, which is heavy for carrying; a lighter print or fewer cells would help.
Not checked: the configurator checks fit and collisions only; material choice is the user's.

finish.summary: Built a hex-base electronics organizer: two removable bins (3-compartment and 2-compartment) in the open-top cells (0,0) and (0,1), a slide drawer on the half-base at (1,0), and a carry handle over the cover triangle at (1,0), (1,-1), (2,-1). House rules applied (open faces capped, joints locked); check_build is clean with meshClash clear. The print estimate is about 2.4 kg and 58 hours, so the build is heavy for a portable piece; portability is only partly addressed. Material and strength are not verified.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 16 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Grab handle
parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
